# About Me

I am currently a student at the University of Winnipeg pursuing an Honours degree in Economics. I have chosen an Honours program because of its rigour and the unique opportunities it provides, such as enrolling in advanced courses and conducting independent research. Upon graduation, I plan to pursue a Master's Degree in Economics.

Outside of the classroom, I enjoy running, biking, reading books, and volunteering with Habitat for Humanity and my local food bank.
